newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bula halts planned H2 production of Well 705.
newsitem.headline: Bula halts planned H2 production of Well 705.

text.p: Bula Resources Holdings Plc said on Wednesday that Well 705 in its Salymskoye Oilfield in Western Siberia will not now be put into production in the second quarter of 1997.

"Regarding the previous announcement made on March 5, 1997, the results and data from well 705 require further technical assessment by the company and, accordingly, this well will not now be put into production in the second quarter of 1997," Bula said in a statement.
Bula said the early onset of the spring thaw made it impossible for the contractor to undertake the announced initial 1997 workover programme.
This programme will not now start until the winter of 1997, it said.
Bula said it would intensify its efforts with regard to the potential it had identified in Libya.
It said it was currently in the process of finalising the exploration and production agreement with a major Canadian oil company regarding Libyan acreage.

Bula said that negotiations were now complete regarding a partnership with a major integrated Central European oil company to apply for an exploration and production sharing agreement for additional prime acreage in Libya.
